title: AFCON 2025 comes to climactic close as hosts Morocco square off against Senegal
summary: Morocco's Atlas Lions will face off against Senegal's Lions of Teranga in Rabat on Sunday night, where the host nation hopes to win its first Africa Cup of Nations title in half a century.
contentText: Morocco's Atlas Lions will face off against Senegal's Lions of Teranga in Rabat on Sunday night, where the host nation hopes to win its first Africa Cup of Nations title in half a century. Watch our special coverage live on FRANCE 24.
